head_proxy_identity.head_source: STEP hole pattern, nozzle end, nominal historical TCP

geometry_sources.joint_body_frames: Seven local STEP meshes driven by nominal standard DH at the actual native solution joints.
geometry_sources.head_cell_state: 15 legacy head component enclosing boxes and nominal supports, bed or printed prism; near or positive clearances are sampled separating-axis lower bounds. A head box contact is a proxy overlap.

joint_encoding: base64, zlib, little-endian float64 rad in row-major order; q_sha256 is SHA256(round(q,12).astype('<f8').tobytes()).

scope.native_head_registration: Historical CAD-to-flange registration inferred from STEP features, not physical tool calibration.
scope.printing: 5 representative perimeters and 3 raster infills; 4 lifts.
scope.entry: Finite explicit unwrapped joint-interpolation options from the supplied absolute anchor; no commanded Cartesian entry curve.
scope.local_sigma: Conservative whole-edge standard-DH lower bound. This model also drives the local body CAD.
scope.native_sigma: Independent central difference of native TCP FK at every 25th entry node and every 10th print knot, plus both ends.
scope.layout_comparison: Only the selected side/overhead finalists; finite entry options and sampled geometry, not a mounting optimum.
scope.mounting: Hypothetical world_T_base is applied mathematically to base-frame native kinematics; the open station is not reoriented.
scope.supplied_anchor: Absolute six-axis coordinates and windings from finalists.anchor; live simulator joints may differ and are never moved.
scope.native_collision: No RoboDK collision engine claim: native IK/FK/sampled Jacobian plus independent local nominal-DH STEP link collision and historical head proxy tests.
scope.excluded: No hardware, controller commands, thermal process, hose/tether model, actual mounting fixture certification or continuous native swept-volume proof.

entry.choice: First all-model witness; if none, first body-only witness; if none, first diagnostic attempt.

entry.scope: Native finite differences at selected nodes, no whole-interval native Jacobian bound.
